components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Purple action button for routine and contextual actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-arsen-purple2, oklch(0.72 0.13 300)), var(--color-arsen-purple, oklch(0.62 0.16 295))); color: white; font: 800 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms ease, filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Acid Button
components.description: Positive action button for saving set data or completing work.
components.css: .ds-btn-acid { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)), var(--color-arsen-acid2, oklch(0.77 0.20 122))); color: #142100; font: 800 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms ease, filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-acid:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-acid:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-acid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary button for canceling or lower-risk actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.10); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-arsen-ink, oklch(0.96 0.005 280)); font: 800 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; background: var(--color-arsen-surface, oklch(0.155 0.016 280)); color: var(--color-arsen-ink, oklch(0.96 0.005 280)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-card span { color: var(--color-arsen-muted, oklch(0.73 0.012 280)); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Centered numeric input for weights, reps, and RIR.
components.css: .ds-number-field { display: block; color: var(--color-arsen-ink, oklch(0.96 0.005 280)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-number-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--color-arsen-muted, oklch(0.73 0.012 280)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-number-field input { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.10); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-arsen-surface, oklch(0.155 0.016 280)); color: var(--color-arsen-ink, oklch(0.96 0.005 280)); padding: 0 12px; text-align: center; font: 800 16px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-number-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact state marker for exercise progress.
components.css: .ds-chip-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 8px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)) 20%, transparent); color: var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)); font: 700 10px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation Item
components.description: Icon-first tab item for the fixed bottom nav.
components.html: Entreno
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-arsen-muted, oklch(0.73 0.012 280)); text-decoration: none; font: 500 11px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--color-arsen-purple, oklch(0.62 0.16 295)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-arsen-acid, oklch(0.86 0.20 125)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bottom Sheet
components.description: Mobile modal surface for registering and editing workout data.
components.css: .ds-sheet { width: 100%; border-top: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.10); border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0; background: var(--color-arsen-bg2, oklch(0.105 0.012 280)); color: var(--color-arsen-ink, oklch(0.96 0.005 280)); padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 -16px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-handle { width: 56px; height: 6px; margin: 0 auto 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25); } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-sheet p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--color-arsen-muted, oklch(0.73 0.012 280)); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Exercise Art Frame
components.description: Framed square image container for exercise or muscle artwork.
components.css: .ds-exercise-art { width: 66px; height: 66px; flex: none; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-arsen-purple, oklch(0.62 0.16 295)) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-arsen-purple, oklch(0.62 0.16 295)) 24%, transparent), var(--color-arsen-bg2, oklch(0.105 0.012 280))); box-shadow: inset 0 0 18px rgb(153 83 255 / 0.18); }

narrative.overview:
Arsen feels like a dense training console carried in one hand: dark, immediate, athletic, and tuned for logging work between sets. The interface is not a lifestyle magazine or a wellness dashboard. It is a compact operating surface where the next action is always close, data stays legible, and visual intensity is reserved for training state.

The visual system uses a near-black shell, violet-purple orientation cues, and acid green performance cues. Surfaces are layered tonally instead of floated with big shadows. Typography is heavy and compact, with small labels doing a lot of information work.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first, app-like, and constrained to a narrow phone column.
High-density cards, sheets, chips, and rows with clear tap targets.
Purple marks navigation, selection, and contextual controls.
Acid green marks completion, saved work, progress, and performance.
Exercise art is dark, contained, and bordered with violet light.

rules.name: The Two Accent Rule
rules.body: Purple answers "where am I and what can I choose"; acid green answers "what improved or was saved." Do not swap those roles casually.

rules.name: The Dark Surface Rule
rules.body: Most screen area must remain neutral dark. Accent color should punctuate state and action, not flood the app.

rules.name: The Heavy-Top Rule
rules.body: Use weight, not large type, to create hierarchy inside the 430px shell.

rules.name: The Zero-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter spacing is normal across the app. Do not use compressed negative tracking or wide decorative tracking.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for surface color, borders, and inset highlights before adding drop shadows.

dos: Do keep screens dense, thumb-friendly, and optimized for repeated workout use.
Do use purple for selection, navigation, and contextual controls.
Do use acid green for progress, saved work, positive completion, and performance.
Do keep card depth subtle: border plus inset highlight is the default.
Do truncate long exercise and routine names instead of letting controls shift.
donts: Don't create wide desktop layouts that break the 430px app-shell discipline.
Don't use pale wellness colors, beige editorial surfaces, or generic SaaS blue as the dominant identity.
Don't put decorative gradients or large shadows behind ordinary cards.
Don't use accent color as broad background decoration; reserve it for state and action.
Don't make exercise art unframed, full-bleed, or purely atmospheric.
